simple.meaning: אֲחַשְׁתָּרִי (ʼăchashtârîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “an achastarite (i.e. courier); the designation (rather than name) of an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲחַשְׁתָּרִי (H326) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲחַשְׁתָּרִי (H326) before moving outward to related references.
